**Note:** You can use this file as you 'working document' where you can try out various investigation ideas and keep notes about your findings. How you use and structure this file is up to you. It is recommended that you keep notes about what you are investigating and what you find as this will make the process of creating your presentation and report easier. Please note that you _do not_ need to submit this file as part of your group project.

Question: To what extent are students’ family socioeconomic status, parental education, and home learning resources associated with their mathematics performance in PISA 2025?


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r load-lib, message = FALSE}
# Add any other libraries here
library(tidyverse)
library(learningtower)
library(haven)

```


```{r load-data}
# load your data 
student_math <- read_rds("data/student_math.rds")
```

```{r detect and remove missing value}
# summary(mean, median, max, NAs)
student_math |>
  summary()
# Remove unnecessary columns and missing math scores
student_math_pro <- student_math |>
  select(-general_family_support) |>
  filter(
    if_all(
      starts_with("math_score_pv"),
      ~ !is.na(.)
    )
  )
```

```{r select researching dataset}
# Select variables for data processing

student_processed <- student_math_pro |>
  select(
    student_id,
    country_code,
    student_age,
    student_gender,
    family_socioeconomic_status,
    family_support,
    home_possessions_index,
    home_ict_resources,
    highest_parental_education,
    parental_education_years,
    highest_parental_occupational_status,
    starts_with("math_score_pv")
  )
# calculate mean score for each student
student_processed <- student_processed |>
  mutate(
    math_score = rowMeans(
      across(starts_with("math_score_pv"))
    )
  ) |>
  select(-starts_with("math_score_pv"))

```

``` {r Tidy Data}
# Variable Table
variable_table <- tibble(
  Variable = names(student_processed)
) |>
  mutate(
    Category = case_when(
      Variable %in% c(
        "student_id",
        "country_code",
        "student_age",
        "student_gender"
      ) ~ "Student Information",

      Variable %in% c(
        "family_socioeconomic_status",
        "highest_parental_occupational_status"
      ) ~ "Family SES",

      Variable %in% c(
        "highest_parental_education",
        "parental_education_years"
      ) ~ "Parental Education",

      Variable %in% c(
        "family_support",
        "home_possessions_index",
        "home_ict_resources"
      ) ~ "Home Learning Environment",

      Variable == "math_score" ~ "Mathematics Performance"
    )
  ) |>
  select(Category, Variable)
variable_table
```
